note: This is the EXIT route out of Hellgate (a deep multi-floor dungeon). Image legend: RED cross = where you currently stand (before going up/down), BLUE cross = where you're heading. Requires Rope + 6 Parcels or Levitate + Key 3012.

steps.text: From the entry platform, go UP the ladder.

steps.heading: W
steps.text: Walk LEFT (west) down a long corridor (skeletons only; going N at the first crossing = ghouls + up to 2 demon skeletons). Go DOWN the hole at the end.

steps.heading: E
steps.text: Go RIGHT (east) down another long passage (normal skeletons). Then DOWN the hole.

steps.heading: W then loop
steps.text: Go LEFT then around a long corridor to the YELLOW CIRCLE — go UP with a rope. Straying: one hole = 5 elves + 2 elf scouts (+~20 bugs deeper), other hole = spiders + giant spider.

steps.heading: SE
steps.text: Go SOUTH-EAST (rotworms). Down the hole, a little S (2 ghouls), UP. Follow S (2 ghouls + 2 rotworms etc), then UP.

steps.heading: S
steps.text: Go S and down the FIRST hole you see. (The second roping spot has Poison Spiders + 1 Ghoul — avoid.)

steps.heading: W
steps.text: Go LEFT through a big room: ~15 Ghouls, ~5 Skeletons, ~2 Bonelords, plus Elder Bonelords (may be lured). ADVICE: hug the SOUTHERN wall to avoid extra mobs. Then DOWN the hole.

steps.heading: NW
steps.text: Go NORTH-WEST (NO monsters). Need 6 Parcels or Levitate to climb up 2 floors, then UP the ladder.

steps.heading: SW
steps.text: Go SOUTH-WEST and UP the hole. (Other hole SE descends to the lava levels — avoid.)
You may need to pull a SWITCH here (opens a bridge 1 floor up). Then just keep going UP (only one way) through many Wasps → surface near Ab'Dendriel.

alternative: Exit via Draconia and Red Bone Castle (separate route).
